description: Typed extraction of obligations and requirements. Record only what the documents say; a later program compares the entries.

statuses.binding: The text plainly requires this value.
statuses.selected_realization: The text presents this value as its author's revisable choice of how to do the work, not as a requirement.
statuses.unspecified: The text says nothing about this property.
statuses.ambiguous: The text supports more than one reading. Do not choose; list every reading in 'readings'.

initiator.meaning: Who must initiate or issue the action.

outcome_owner.meaning: Who or what must bring about the outcome.

verifier.meaning: Who must establish that the outcome holds.

verifier_independence.meaning: Whether the verifier must be independent of the acting component.

path_fact.meaning: Required facts about how the outcome is produced.

field_rules: binding and selected_realization require a non-empty 'value'.
unspecified requires an empty 'value' and no 'readings'.
ambiguous requires an empty 'value' and at least two 'readings', each a non-empty list of allowed tokens.
verifier_independence values are lists of exactly one of 'required' or 'not_required'.
any use of 'other' requires 'other_text' quoting the text.

entry.document: a document id exactly as shown in the task (DOC-1, DOC-2, ...)
entry.role: 'parent' for an entry from a PARENT or SOURCE document; 'derived' for an entry from a DERIVED document
entry.span: exact text quoted from that document
entry.fields: object mapping property name to {status, value, readings?, other_text?}; omit a property only if it is unspecified
entry.semantics_owner: parent entries only, optional: {status, names: [owner names as written in the documents], span}

derived_only.asserted_as: one of inherited, proposed, new, realization_choice, unchanged
derived_only.references_made: list of the references the derived document itself makes for this requirement: {kind: specific|general, text: the citation exactly as written, target_document: a document id or null}; empty list if it cites nothing
derived_only.support_candidates: object mapping each property to a list of parent entry ids that bear on that property, whether or not they fully state it; empty list if none
derived_only.adopted_by: optional: {status, names: [who the document says adopts or imposes this requirement, as written], span}
